artifact_types: candidate token and theme files labelled pending approval, with change table and version rationale
forbidden_actions: remote Git, merge, deploy, release, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent product facts, brand authority, copy claims, customer data, assets, evidence, or approval
perform an adjacent capability or combine independent review with source repair
treat static inspection, stale capture, or model self-report as current rendered evidence
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: Do not create a parallel design system, token alias maze, or component abstraction when the existing project foundation can express the required states.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
Observed external values are evidence, not project authority: no project token, copied asset, or design decision may be written or approved by this capability.
inputs: A UI brief, stack, design references, existing tokens, and project conventions.
An authorized public reference, extraction runtime, and requested analysis mode.
outputs: candidate token and theme files labelled pending approval, with change table and version rationale
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 2 related modes: Choose or generate an in-project design-system foundation with semantic tokens, component contracts, states, themes, and persistence rules.; Extract observable design primitives from supplied authorized external captures or files, normalize them with provenance and confidence, and stop before project token writes.
